name: Farrera (Spain)
description: Red field charged with a white horseshoe with six red nail holes, above a white chevron along the lower edge with green triangles in the lower corners.
history: The official flag of Farrera is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, red, with the white horseshoe with six red nail holes of the arms at the centre, 1/2 of the height of the cloth and set at 1/10 from the upper edge, with two right-angled triangles in the lower corners; approved by the municipal council on 17 June 2022, approved by the Department of the Presidency on 12 April 2023 and published in the DOGC on 18 April 2023.

features.role: horseshoe with six red nail holes
chevron along the lower part with its point at the lower centre
triangles in the lower hoist and lower fly corners
